systems.platform: three mobile applications: HEW app, Focal Person app, Referral app
systems.tiers: Health Extension Workers at health posts and on home visits in rural communities, in eCHIS-implementing woredas; referrals to and from health centres
community level, Health Extension Program, introduced 2008

note: The only system described is eCHIS, launched by the Ministry of Health in 2018 for Health Extension Workers, a community-class system, so no fact is recorded. The study compares woredas with and without eCHIS (household data July-August 2024) and gives no coverage count.
